newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo in $29 mln Vietnam building deal.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo in $29 mln Vietnam building deal.

text.p: Daewoo Corp, the foreign trading and construction unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Friday it had won a $29 million order from the Vietnam government to construct a road.

Daewoo begins construction on the 56-kilometre road connecting Vietnam's northern cities of Chi Linh and Bieu Nhgi from early 1997, a Daewoo spokesman said. He anticipated it would take 33 months to complete.
Vietnam will pay $24 million of the contracted amount with special loans it agreed to receive from South Korea's Economic Development and Cooperation Fund, he said.
The remaining $5 million will be paid over a 10-year period after the construction is completed in mid-1999, he added.
